subject: MSA + Order Form (renewal) — execution plan and pending redlines
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novusai.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procure@novusai.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MSA and Order Form for renewal — redlines attached

Hi Olga / Rishi,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Attached are the redlines from our legal and procurement teams (NovusAI_MSA_Redline_from_Customer_v2.docx and a lightly edited order form). Our key asks are:

- Confirm Exhibit D (data handling) language — we need a clear 30‑day export window for logs when accounts are decommissioned.
- Add an explicit audit window for SOC2 evidence (60 days post-request).
- Clarify billing for the proposed capacity uplift (2x baseline) and whether metered overages will be invoiced monthly or on renewal.

We are targeting a go‑live of June 1, 2028 for the expanded capacity, and we want to have the agreement fully executed by May 22 to allow provisioning. Procurement is prepared to do DocuSign once you return a consolidated counter.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the consolidated draft and whether you expect any commercial concessions?

Attachments: NovusAI_MSA_Redline_from_Customer_v2.docx; OrderForm_NovusAI_2028-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Sam Torres
Head of Procurement, NovusAI
Sam.Torres@novusai.com
procure@novusai.com

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novusai.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and Order Form for renewal — redlines attached

Sam — thanks for sending these over. Received and reviewed at a high level. Quick plan from our side:

1) Rishi will drive commercial reconciliation (pricing, billing cadence for uplift, credits).
2) Karthik will own the legal language for Exhibit D and audit window.
3) I'll produce a consolidated redline (internal_redline_tracker.csv + consolidated MSA) by EOD tomorrow (May 3).

A couple of immediate notes:
- We can accommodate a 60‑day audit evidence window; we'll need to align on exact artifacts (SOC2 report vs. raw logs).
- The 30‑day export window is reasonable but we need to confirm retention implications for KV cache and endpoint logs — Kar thik, can you confirm whether our existing infra warrants changes to the export SLA?

Sam, is the June 1 go‑live fixed or a target? If provisioning needs more runway we can propose a phased uplift (50% capacity first week, full uplift by June 15) to reduce risk.

I'll attach the consolidated tracker and a first pass MSA counter once Karthik gives the legal green light.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Lead, Renewals — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
(415) 555‑0199

Attachment: internal_redline_tracker.csv

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and Order Form for renewal — redlines attached

Thanks for the ping — I reviewed NovusAI's redlines. High‑level suggestions below (will produce tracked changes in the consolidated MSA):

- Exhibit D / Data handling: Replace the proposed \"30 days\" single clause with this two‑tier approach:
  * Active export window: 30 calendar days after termination for customer-initiated exports (satisfies Novus ask).
  * Archived copy retention: Redwood will retain encrypted backups for an additional 60 days solely for compliance investigations; we will not process requests against archived copies except for subpoenas or lawful requests.

- SOC2 evidence: We can commit to producing applicable SOC2 artifact extracts within 60 days of a formal request, subject to a mutual NDA for sharing any customer‑specific logs. Add an explicit note that incident root cause reports are produced at our discretion.

- Billing cadence for uplift: Propose invoicing overage/metering monthly with reconciliation at renewal. If Novus requires fixed invoicing at time of uplift, we can discuss a one‑time prepay option.

Open points for Novus legal: export cryptography/export control clause (are they subject to additional regulatory export constraints?), and indemnity carveouts around third‑party embeddings.

I'll compile tracked changes and a short redline rationale to help procurement triage. Olga, will you confirm if we should include an SLA credit schedule for the 2x uplift period? Rishi — commercial decision on credits?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novusai.com>, procure@novusai.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and Order Form for renewal — redlines attached

Sam — appreciate the clarity. Quick commercial alignment from our side:

- Capacity uplift: We confirm the 2x baseline uplift request. Proposed billing: start charging for uplift on the effective date of the amendment and invoice monthly. We will provide a usage dashboard for transparency; any overage reconciliation will appear on the next monthly invoice.
- SLA credit: as a gesture for the committed uplift and to expedite signature, Redwood can offer a one‑time operational credit equal to 5% of the first month’s uplift bill if we miss the committed provisioning date. This is limited to the uplift portion only.
- Execution path: we prefer DocuSign for speed. If Novus signs by May 22 we can meet a June 1 provisioning target; otherwise we recommend the phased uplift Olga suggested.

Next steps:
1) We will publish a consolidated MSA with tracked changes and a clean order form by EOD May 3.
2) Karthik will include the data/export language options; Sam, please highlight any mandatory export controls applicable to Novus.
3) Olga will send the DocuSign envelope once counters are accepted.

If that looks OK, please reply all with your preferred signatory and sign order (DocuSign or manual).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Director, Renewals — Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: consolidated counter will follow

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@novusai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procure@novusai.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 05 May 2028 14:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MSA and Order Form for renewal — redlines attached

Rishi / Olga — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the credit offer. Procurement reviewed your approach and we have one remaining item: export controls. NovusAI is subject to specific export restrictions for certain models and datasets (we are in touch with legal here). We need an explicit representation in the MSA that Redwood will comply with export control directives and an escalation path if a request conflicts with applicable law.

If you can add the suggested narrow language around export controls and provide the consolidated tracked document, we will route for final signoff. We can sign via DocuSign — signatory will be Sam Torres (CEO for procurement authority).

Assuming those two changes are in the consolidated counter, procurement will sign and hit the May 22 objective. Provisioning team will then follow the phased approach if the June 1 target looks tight.

Thanks — I look forward to the consolidated doc.
Sam Torres
Head of Procurement, NovusAI
